$comment: Payroll values from the law for docs/24 and migration 0010. Merge into the employment standards edition in Step 7 with the other additions files. Every entry is verify_at_load until checked against the statute; a jurisdiction an organization uses with no entry stops with JURISDICTION_RULE_MISSING when the value is needed.

keys.garnishment_protection: Share of wages protected from garnishment (exempt_percent), the share protected from a support order where it differs, and minimum protected amounts. CanDo works out the deduction from the order and this rule; payroll confirms the first deduction (docs/24 §6.3).
keys.banked_time: Limits on banked overtime (time off in lieu): when it must be used or paid out (docs/24 §5.3).
keys.vacation_pay_each_cheque: Whether vacation pay may be paid on each cheque and what it needs (the employee's written agreement, a collective agreement) (docs/24 §5.1).
keys.tax_slip_delivery: How tax slips reach employees: the due date, when a secure portal needs no consent, when consent is needed, email, and paper copies (CRA; nationwide).
keys.pay_statement_electronic: Whether a pay statement may be given electronically and what the employee must be able to do with it (province).

nationwide.$comment: Rules that apply to every employer in Canada.

tax_slip_delivery.due: last day of February of the year after the slips' year
tax_slip_delivery.cite: CRA, Distribute the slips (canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/businesses/topics/payroll/file-information-returns-slip-summaries/distribute-slips.html); Income Tax Regulations s. 209
